_approach: Halftime-to-fulltime lift: bar 1 sits in halftime with the snare on beat 3 only (the autonomic law), bar 2 quietly reintroduces 2-and-4 alongside the beat-3 anchor as the kick doubles its pace, and bar 3 commits fully to two-step with the snare accelerating into a roll that peaks and then leaves the last 16th silent before the return to full tempo. Ref: United By Bass's autonomic/halftime description; docs/styles/dnb.md's note on halftime as the one exception to the 2-and-4 law.
